_instructions: Fill this out to document what you offer and how you're positioned. AI uses this to understand your business.

overview._instructions: The big picture of what you do.
overview.what_you_do: Tree removal, trimming, and stump grinding for homeowners in Greenville, SC and nearby towns.
overview.who_you_serve: Homeowners in Greenville, SC and nearby towns.
overview.primary_transformation: Homeowners go from worrying about a dangerous or overgrown tree to having it safely handled and the yard cleaned up.
overview.mission: To make Greenville homeowners' trees safe and their yards usable again, so they never have to gamble on a dangerous tree.
overview.vision: To become Greenville's most trusted tree service, known for safe work and clean yards.

positioning._instructions: How you're different from everyone else.
positioning.unique_angle: We treat safety first and always leave the yard clean.
positioning.core_philosophy: A tree is never worth the risk of a fall.
positioning.methodology: From first call to finished yard: a free site visit, a recommendation of removal or trimming based on the tree's condition, and yard cleanup before we leave.
positioning.problem_you_solve: A dangerous or overgrown tree on the homeowner's property, such as a leaning oak over the house, a stump in the yard, or a tree down after a storm.
positioning.core_value_proposition: A safe, clean, one-call tree job from free estimate to finished yard.

offerings._instructions: What can people buy or access?

free_offerings.name: Free site visit and estimate
free_offerings.description: We'll come out to look at your tree, explain what needs doing, and give you a written quote at no charge.
free_offerings.where_to_get_it: Website download page, or by phone

free_offerings.name: Storm damage checklist
free_offerings.description: A one-page guide to what to do when a tree is down or leaning after a storm: what to keep clear, what to avoid, and when to call a professional.

free_offerings.name: Tree care guide
free_offerings.description: Simple advice on pruning, watering, and spotting a dangerous tree before it becomes an emergency.

paid_offerings.name: Tree removal
paid_offerings.description: Safe removal of dangerous, dead, or unwanted trees from a homeowner's property.

paid_offerings.name: Trimming and pruning
paid_offerings.description: Trimming and pruning to clear overgrown branches and keep trees healthy and safe.

paid_offerings.name: Stump grinding
paid_offerings.description: Grinding down stumps left in the yard after a tree is removed.

paid_offerings.name: Arborist services
paid_offerings.description: Professional assessment of a tree's health and hazards, with a recommendation on what it needs.

paid_offerings.name: Emergency storm removal
paid_offerings.description: Removal of trees that have come down or are leaning dangerously after a storm.

paid_offerings.name: Land clearing
paid_offerings.description: Clearing trees and brush from a lot or property.

paid_offerings.name: Crane tree removal
paid_offerings.description: Crane-assisted removal of large or hard-to-reach trees.

paid_offerings.name: Commercial and HOA tree service
paid_offerings.description: Tree removal, trimming, and care for businesses, HOAs, and other commercial properties.
